items.title: Atmos Padel raises £3.3m to fund three new UK clubs
items.summary: North West operator Atmos Padel, backed by Arbor Ventures, has raised £3.3m (a £2.7m equity round plus a £625,000 NatWest debt facility). It runs six outdoor clubs with 23 courts and plans new clubs in Altrincham, Bexhill-on-Sea and Hucknall by end of March 2027.

items.title: Padel Investments Ltd plans four courts at Delta Hotels Manchester Airport, Hale Barns
items.summary: Padel Investments Ltd has applied to Trafford Council for four padel courts, a single-storey clubhouse and a retractable canopy at the Hale Road hotel, seeking a five-year temporary permission linked to HS2 safeguarding.

items.title: Elland padel club Goat Haus faces resident objections over noise and parking as it seeks alcohol licence
items.summary: Goat Haus on South Lane, Elland, has applied to Calderdale Council to sell alcohol and host live music 6am–10pm daily; two ward councillors and five residents have objected citing ball noise and pavement parking, ahead of a licensing sub-committee hearing.

items.title: Brackley farm-diversification padel scheme fails at appeal despite no sequential test needed
items.summary: An Inspector upheld West Northamptonshire Council's refusal of two indoor courts in a new agricultural-style building at Hall Farm, Radstone, on landscape grounds, while accepting the scheme did not require a town centre sequential test.

items.title: Three-court indoor padel centre proposed at Valley Road Business Park, Birkenhead
items.summary: An application to Wirral Council seeks confirmation that converting an industrial unit near Birkenhead North station into three indoor padel courts with changing and spectator facilities would not need planning permission.

items.title: Plans submitted for two indoor padel courts on Green Belt at Grays school
items.summary: South West Essex Community Education Trust has applied to build an almost 10m-high sports hall housing two padel courts at William Edwards School, Grays, on Metropolitan Green Belt land, for pupil and community use.

items.title: Astbury Golf & Lodge Resort near Bridgnorth applies to convert estate barn into two padel courts
items.summary: The owners of the Astbury Golf & Lodge Resort (formerly Astbury Hall) have applied to Shropshire Council to use a barn on the estate to house two padel courts. Documents say the change would be temporary, with a proposed limit of 10 years.

items.title: Planning approved for two covered padel courts at Guildford Lido
items.summary: Councillors approved two fully covered, lit padel courts at Guildford Lido, replacing a mini-golf course and an underutilised building that will be demolished.

items.title: The Linden Padel Club sets 28 November opening for four-court Grimsby/Cleethorpes venue
items.summary: Investor-backed Linden Padel Club on Clee Road, next to Cleethorpes Town FC, will open on Saturday 28 November with four doubles courts, racket hire and ball sales.

items.title: Colchester Fitness Centre submits plans for two padel courts at Peartree Leisure Park
items.summary: Colchester Fitness Centre Ltd is seeking to amend an existing consent to build two padel courts with a canopy, enclosures and toilet on 0.2ha of vacant hardstanding off Moss Road.

items.title: Pulse Padel's five-court Hawley Garden Centre scheme near Dartford recommended for refusal
items.summary: Dartford council officers recommend refusing Pulse Padel's plans for four double and one single covered court at Hawley Garden Centre, Sutton-at-Hone, citing green belt harm and no evidenced unmet need, despite 245+ letters of support. Planning committee decides on 19 November.

items.title: Plans submitted to convert former Bradford play centre into three-court indoor padel venue
items.summary: An application to Bradford Council seeks to convert vacant Unit 5 Duncombe Way, Lidget Green, off Thornton Road, into three indoor padel courts with changing facilities, viewing areas and a reconfigured 25-space car park.
items.source: Bradford Telegraph and Argus (via Yahoo News UK)

items.title: Residents object to four-court padel plan at Wickham Park Golf Club
items.summary: Plans for four padel courts with lighting and parking at Wickham Park Golf Club on Titchfield Lane have drawn 11 public objections citing traffic, parking, noise and light pollution.

items.title: South Kesteven council weighs 15-year lease to PadelHaus for seven courts at Grantham Meres
items.summary: South Kesteven District Council is considering a 15-year lease to PadelHaus for three indoor and four outdoor courts at Grantham Meres Leisure Centre, with the operator funding redevelopment and paying rent. PadelHaus was picked from three proposals as the most financially advantageous; the district currently has no padel venues.

items.title: Pembrokeshire Padel seeks retrospective planning for two-court venue at Withybush Showground
items.summary: Pembrokeshire Padel Ltd, which launched in October, has applied for retrospective permission to use part of the Camrose Building at Withybush Showground, Haverfordwest, for two indoor courts open 6am–11pm and booked via Playtomic.

items.title: Padel Social Club pushes five-court O2 Greenwich club opening to January 2027
items.summary: Padel Social Club's five-court club at The O2 in Greenwich will now open in January 2027, per the operator's website, later than the November 2026 date reported at its May funding round. Founding memberships are on sale at £575 a year.

items.title: Netside Padel submits plans for three-court padel facility at Barns Court, Crawley Down
items.summary: Netside Padel has applied for permission to build three padel courts, a café, changing rooms and WCs on land next to the Barns Court commercial and leisure business park in Crawley Down. The applicant says the site lies outside the settlement boundary but represents an appropriate leisure use.

items.title: Plans submitted for four covered padel courts at Fitness Factory, Crumlin
items.summary: Fitness Factory has applied to Caerphilly County Borough Council to build four covered padel courts next to its gym on Pen y Fan Industrial Estate. The application (26/0707/FULL) is out for consultation.

items.title: At least 23 padel clubs opened across the UK in 2026, Padel Underground count finds
items.summary: Padel Underground's region-by-region round-up lists every UK padel club it could confirm opened between 1 January and 11 November 2026, from Ballymoney to Exeter, with dates and court counts checked against operator, council or press sources. Slazenger Padel Clubs Exeter is the largest, with nine indoor courts, and Padel United Redbridge is London's newest.

items.title: 12-court padel venue proposed for Cascades Shopping Centre car park roof in Portsmouth
items.summary: Portsmouth Cascades Padel Limited, alongside developer Padel Tree, has submitted plans to Portsmouth City Council for 11 outdoor rooftop courts on the multi-storey car park plus one indoor court in the centre's atrium.

items.title: Leeds tennis club seeks permission for two more padel courts as usage hits 87%
items.summary: Chapel Allerton Tennis and Squash Club has applied to Leeds City Council to convert a tennis court into two padel courts. Its design report says weekday 9am-9pm padel usage is about 87%, versus 32% for its outdoor tennis courts.

items.title: BallBall app aggregates open matches across platforms: 958 open London games found in one week
items.summary: BallBall pulls open games and events from different booking platforms, clubs and communities into one app. Its London snapshot on 14 October found 958 open matches over the following seven days, with 2,106 available player places and 211 matches one player short.

items.title: Second UK Padel Convention draws 1,027 attendees at The Padel Club, Gloucester Quays
items.summary: The Vitality UK Padel Convention grew from 780 attendees in 2025 to 1,027 in 2026, with 58+ exhibitors on a sold-out floor. Club owners, operators, investors, suppliers and governing body leaders attended, with the LTA, Playtomic and Padel World Summit among event partners.

items.title: MejorSet and Padel Social Club: London operator moves to Full Panoramic courts, Kentish Town site planned
items.summary: An advertorial says Padel Social Club has 11 courts across Earl's Court and Paddington, both fitted with MejorSet Full Panoramic courts. Planned projects include revamping its O2 courts and building an eight-court facility in Kentish Town.

items.title: Padel at the Pub opens two courts at The Black Horse in Chesham
items.summary: Padel at the Pub has opened two padel courts at The Black Horse in Chesham, Buckinghamshire, bookable via Playtomic from £32 an hour with no membership. The operator says the courts are currently uncovered.

items.title: Foundry Padel Club opens in Burgess Hill with four indoor courts
items.summary: Family-run Foundry Padel Club on Consort Way, Victoria Business Park, has four indoor panoramic courts, no membership requirement and Playtomic booking, plus a café-bar, reformer Pilates and a golf simulator. The club has not published an exact opening date.

items.title: Padel's north/south price divide: a statistical deep dive
items.summary: Playskan data shows London padel averages £47 per hour versus £37 in Manchester, £33 in Liverpool and £32 in Leeds, against a UK average of £34. London courts also run at 66% occupancy versus 50% in Manchester.

items.title: UK passes 3,000 padel courts landmark
items.summary: Padel Genie counts 3,053 courts across 890 clubs in Britain as of 24 October 2026, with 2,707 in England, 124 in Northern Ireland, 112 in Scotland and 110 in Wales. It expects at least 4,000 courts within a year.

items.title: Council refusal for popular padel court branded 'shortsighted'
items.summary: West Berkshire Council refused retrospective planning permission for a padel court at The Retreat at Elcot Park hotel near Newbury, voting seven to one with one abstention, citing noise and lack of a nearby bus stop. The court has about 1,500 registered players and 64 of 67 online comments supported it.

items.title: Padel Alba builds club inside its own factory
items.summary: UK court supplier Padel Alba has invested EUR 750,000 in a new Alicante factory with an on-site four-court club that doubles as a showroom. The expanded plant could raise output from 10 courts a week to as many as 30.

items.title: LTA: padel hits 1.5 million players across 2,445 courts at 682 British venues
items.summary: On World Padel Day the LTA reported 1.5 million adult and junior players, up from 860,000 at the end of 2025 and 15,000 in 2019. Britain now has 2,445 courts across 682 venues.

items.title: Sheffield tennis club withdraws padel court bid after noise complaints
items.summary: Ecclesall Lawn Tennis Club withdrew its retrospective planning application for a padel court before Sheffield's planning committee met on 13 October. Officers had recommended refusal after 28 residents complained about noise, and the council issued an abatement notice in June preventing use of the court.

items.title: Ace Padel nets £500,000 funding to serve up expansion plans
items.summary: Midlands operator Ace Padel received a £500,000 loan from the Midlands Engine Investment Fund II, managed by Frontier Development Capital. It opens its fifth club in Fenton, Stoke-on-Trent on 17 October, with further venues planned for Coventry, Sefton and Morpeth.

items.title: UK 'first' as Powerleague creates 'regional padel lead' roles
items.summary: Powerleague is creating five full-time regional padel lead positions across its sites. It has 51 padel courts across 12 football venues, with four more sites adding padel before year end, and aims to add padel to almost half of its 43 football sites.

items.title: Padel United is opening 3 covered courts in Redbridge
items.summary: East London facility debuts with three fully covered courts and Playtomic booking.

items.title: Social Sport Society's flagship Wembley padel club closes
items.summary: Social Sports Society's three-court Wembley Park club has shut after the developer revoked its lease over unpaid rent. The company has filed notice of intent to appoint administrators and is in a financing dispute with partner Mindspring Padel.

items.title: Padel at the Pub opens first site at The Black Horse, Chesham
items.summary: Padel at the Pub has launched its first site at The Black Horse pub in Chesham, Buckinghamshire, with two courts and a Padel Café, open daily 7am-10pm.

items.title: Britain's first floating padel courts open in Liverpool
items.summary: Vibora Liverpool Waters opened at Princes Dock on 26 September with two courts operating; a third court and clubhouse expansion are planned for later this year.

items.title: Sunderland padel courts decision due as council recommends approval for Silksworth site
items.summary: Sunderland City Council's planning and highways committee votes on 28 September on Everyone Active's plan to convert four outdoor tennis courts at Silksworth Community Pool, Tennis and Wellness Centre into four covered padel courts; council officers have recommended approval, citing rising padel demand and year-round use of racket-sport facilities.

items.title: Seven-court padel club planned for former warehouse in Mold
items.summary: The Lob Padel Club has applied to Flintshire County Council to change Unit 1 on Stephen Gray Road, Bromfield Industrial Estate, from industrial/storage to leisure use for an indoor centre with five doubles and two singles courts (including wheelchair-accessible courts), plus café and shop. The unit sits on protected employment land; the landlord's marketing report said three of seven enquiries for it came from padel operators.

items.title: Play Padel's new club at Sheffield's Meadowhall to open soon
items.summary: Play Padel Group will open its second venue at Meadowhall shopping centre at the end of October with eight indoor courts (one singles, seven doubles), cafe, bar and warm-up gym. It is offering 100 founding memberships at £99 for 12 months.

items.title: Padel clubs and self-employed coaches: legal guidance
items.summary: Myerson Solicitors sets out employment-status risks for operators engaging coaches as self-employed: if a tribunal or HMRC reclassifies them, clubs face backdated holiday pay, minimum wage, pension and tax exposure.

items.title: Southampton council approves six covered padel courts in £1m Outdoor Sports Centre plan
items.summary: Southampton City Council's Cabinet approved plans for six covered padel courts as part of a redevelopment of the Outdoor Sports Centre in Bassett, replacing an underused tennis court and netball area. The £1m scheme is projected to turn a profit within 10 years, with construction due to start in early 2027 and opening expected June 2027.

items.title: UK PADEL opens at Willen Lake on 17 October — Milton Keynes gets six more courts
items.summary: Four covered all-weather courts and two open-air courts, with daily social mix-in sessions.

items.title: Scottish Open Padel Championships streamed live on BBC iPlayer
items.summary: Finals from the inaugural Glasgow event went out on BBC iPlayer — a step up in mainstream visibility for UK padel.

items.title: Padel courts planned for Lancing leisure centre
items.summary: South Downs Leisure has applied to Adur District Council to replace an astroturf pitch at Lancing Manor Leisure Centre with three floodlit padel courts; the LTA has endorsed the plan. Decision deadline is 12 November 2026.

items.title: Four covered padel courts proposed at Birchwood Park Golf and Country Club, Dartford
items.summary: A planning application to Dartford council would remove driving range bays at Birchwood Park in Wilmington to make way for four covered padel courts, an outdoor terrace and a redirected public footpath.

items.title: Structuring padel leases for growth: five key points for operators
items.summary: Legal briefing on how operators should structure leases when expanding.

items.title: The Padel Club raises £3m to triple its footprint
items.summary: Wilmslow-founded operator takes NPIF II / PXN backing to fund eight new sites (Chester, Liverpool, Knutsford, Sheffield, Cardiff, Brighton, Sutton Coldfield), taking it to 85 courts. Reports roughly 100% revenue growth in H1 2026.

items.title: The Bath curse is broken — but padel “must do more to change the narrative”
items.summary: Smash Padel's Rupert Taylor on the Bath opening and the perception problem the industry still has.

items.title: Empower Padel and LTA launch programme to boost women's padel
items.summary: Joint participation programme targeting women and girls.

items.title: Padel Social Club secures £5.5m to open three new London venues
items.summary: Clark Group, Active Partners and Stormzy back 17 new courts at Paddington, Kentish Town and The O2. Its Earls Court site runs above 95% peak-time occupancy across 30,000+ players.
